description: The pie chart represents the distribution of various categories in a dataset. There are a total of 12 slices, each representing a different category. The categories and their respective proportions are as follows: Daily Life (7.1%), Pet & Animal (5.5%), Med & Health (6.7%), History (8.2%), Law (5.1%), Science (6.7%), Econ. & Fin. (18.4%), Business (5.9%), Geography (2.7%), Math (1.2%), Game&Anime (8.2%), and an unnamed category with 24.3%. The chart includes percentage labels inside the slices, and the segments are ordered by size, with the largest segment being the unnamed category at 24.3%.
